Annual price indices

Source: R/cp_pi2cy.R
pi_annual.Rd

Annual price indices (previous year average = 100) derived from quarterly or monthly price indices over the previous year.

Usage

pi_annual(pi, cp = NULL, method = c("weighted", "mean"))

Arguments

pi

Quarterly or monthly price indices over the previous year (previous year average = 100), ts or mts.

cp

Current prices, with the same structure as pi. Needed for method = "weighted".

method

"weighted" (default) for the weighted average of the price indices (implicit annual price index), "mean" for their simple average.

Value

An annual ts (or mts) with the structure of pi. It is NA for the incomplete years and the years without price indices (e.g. the reference year).

Details

With method = "weighted" (the default), the annual price index is the weighted average of the sub-annual price indices, the weights being the volumes at the prices of the previous year (\(cp / pi \times 100\)): it is the implicit price index, i.e. the annual current prices divided by the annual sum of the sub-annual volumes at the prices of the previous year, $$pi_y = 100 \times \frac{\sum_q cp_q}{\sum_q cp_q / pi_q \times 100}.$$ It is consistent with the sub-annual data (as the unit value in example 8.1 of the IMF QNA Manual): the annual volume at the prices of the previous year is the annual sum of the sub-annual ones. This is what is used in examples 8.3, 8.8 and 8.9 of the manual, and by cp_pi2cy().

With method = "mean", the annual price index is the simple average of the sub-annual price indices: the annual volumes are then not exactly the annual sums of the sub-annual ones.

The sub-annual price indices themselves are normalised on the simple average of the previous year (see pi_py2pp()): this is not affected by method.

References

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

See also

cp_pi2cy(), pi_py2pp()

Examples

pi_annual(imf_pi, imf_cp)
#> Time Series:
#> Start = 2010 
#> End = 2013 
#> Frequency = 1 
#>              A         B
#> 2010        NA        NA
#> 2011 102.63273  98.50115
#> 2012 101.72096  98.33747
#> 2013  99.34479 101.08064
pi_annual(imf_pi, method = "mean")
#> Time Series:
#> Start = 2010 
#> End = 2013 
#> Frequency = 1 
#>            A       B
#> 2010      NA      NA
#> 2011 102.625  98.500
#> 2012 101.750  98.375
#> 2013  99.375 101.125
# Annual Fisher volume index (previous year = 100)
fisher(stats::aggregate(imf_cp), pi_annual(imf_pi, imf_cp))
#> Time Series:
#> Start = 2011 
#> End = 2013 
#> Frequency = 1 
#> [1] 100.7851 100.9985 102.2264
